# 1. Data / 数据

Chapter 5 tests whether microbial traits are associated with **host breadth
(HB)**, using the same genus-level host-breadth values computed in Chapter 4
(`N` host genera per ASV; NRH = 0). All trait tests are HBS-only: the
one-host/NRH contrast (OHA) is not used. Only ASVs with `host_breadth >= 1` enter
the models, so each effect is the change in trait prevalence per doubling of
host breadth among host-associated ASVs.

Inputs are the per-ASV 16S trait tables (FAPROTAX2, BugBase and metaTraits), the
PICRUSt2 KO presence matrix, and the Chapter 4 host-breadth tables. Per-pool host breadth is taken directly from
`Tab_4_asv_classification.tsv`, i.e. an ASV's host breadth recomputed within that
qualified pool's representative presence matrix.

```{r data}
KO_FILE <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "function_prediction", "ko_data_nsti_filtered.txt")
KO_LEVEL_FILE <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "db", "ko_level_table.txt")
PGPG_FILE <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "db", "ko_pgpg_levels.txt")

# Chapter 4 host breadth (merged) and qualified pool definitions
hb_merged <- list(`16S` = fread(file.path(
  ch_dir("ch4_generality", "tables"), "Tab_4_gos_merged_16s.tsv")))

# Trait table: shipped with the repository; if absent (or SEED_RECOMPUTE=traits),
# rebuild from the raw annotations and the Chapter 4 ASV universe.
# 性状表默认读取随仓库文件；缺失或指定重算时，用原始注释与 Ch4 ASV 集重建。
trait_candidates <- precomp_candidates("taxonomy_16s_traits.txt", "traits")
trait_file <- if (!want_recompute("traits")) {
  hit <- trait_candidates[file.exists(trait_candidates)]
  if (length(hit)) hit[1] else NA_character_
} else NA_character_
if (is.na(trait_file)) {
  tr16 <- build_trait_table(hb_merged[["16S"]]$ASV_ID)
  trait_file <- file.path(PREPARED_DIR, "precomputed", "taxonomy_16s_traits.txt")
  dir.create(dirname(trait_file), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  data.table::fwrite(tr16, trait_file, sep = "\t", na = "NA")
}
tr <- list(`16S` = data.table::fread(trait_file, sep = "\t",
                                     na.strings = c("NA", ""),
                                     check.names = FALSE))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(tr[["16S"]]$taxid))

pool_summary <- fread(file.path(ch_dir("ch4_generality", "tables"),
                                "Tab_4_pool_summary.tsv"))
pools16 <- pool_summary[kingdom == "16S" & included == TRUE]
pools16[, grain := factor(grain,
                          levels = c("Coarse A", "Coarse B", "Medium", "Fine"))]
setorder(pools16, grain, pool)
POOLS16 <- pools16$pool

# Per-pool host breadth, long table (all ASVs x all qualified 16S pools)
cls_pool <- fread(file.path(ch_dir("ch4_generality", "tables"),
                            "Tab_4_asv_classification.tsv"))
cls_pool <- cls_pool[kingdom == "16S" & pool %in% POOLS16]
stopifnot(nrow(cls_pool) == nrow(tr[["16S"]]) * length(POOLS16))
cls_list <- split(cls_pool, by = "pool")
hb_pools <- lapply(cls_list, function(x) {
  x$host_breadth[match(tr[["16S"]]$taxid, x$ASV_ID)]
})
stopifnot(all(vapply(hb_pools, length, integer(1)) == nrow(tr[["16S"]])))

hb16  <- setNames(hb_merged[["16S"]]$host_breadth[match(
  tr[["16S"]]$taxid, hb_merged[["16S"]]$ASV_ID)], tr[["16S"]]$taxid)
stopifnot(!anyNA(hb16))

cat(sprintf("16S ASV: %d (%d with HB>=1)\n",
            nrow(tr[["16S"]]), sum(hb16 >= 1)))
cat(sprintf("qualified 16S pools: %d\n", length(POOLS16)))
```

# 2. Shared helpers / 公共函数

## 2.1 Trait classification / 性状分类

Traits are split into boolean (TRUE/FALSE) and numeric columns after removing
metadata and the two BugBase categorical fields (`Aerobic_type`, `Gram_type`),
which are one-hot encoded by their component booleans. `flag` encodes why a
trait was not tested; only `flag == "ok"` traits receive FDR values and enter
figures.

```{r helpers-traits}
META_TR <- c("taxid", "Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus",
             "Species", "Sub_Species", "n_hosts", "mean_dist", "dispersion",
             "category")
EXCL16 <- c("bugbase_ggid", "bugbase_Aerobic_type", "bugbase_Gram_type")

to_logical <- function(x) {
  y <- rep(NA, length(x))
  y[x == "TRUE" | x == TRUE] <- TRUE
  y[x == "FALSE" | x == FALSE] <- FALSE
  y
}
is_bool_col <- function(x) {
  v <- as.character(x[!is.na(x)])
  v <- v[v != ""]
  length(v) > 0 && all(v %in% c("TRUE", "FALSE"))
}
classify_traits <- function(d, cols) {
  bool <- cols[vapply(cols, function(tc) is_bool_col(d[[tc]]), logical(1))]
  rest <- setdiff(cols, bool)
  num <- rest[vapply(rest, function(tc) {
    x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d[[tc]]))
    !all(is.na(x))
  }, logical(1))]
  list(boolean = bool, numeric = num, other = setdiff(rest, num))
}
trait_source <- function(x) {
  ifelse(grepl("^bugbase_", x), "BugBase",
    ifelse(grepl("^faprotax_", x), "FAPROTAX2",
      ifelse(grepl("^metatraits_", x), "MetaTraits", "Other")))
}
short_label <- function(x) {
  y <- sub("^(bugbase|faprotax|metatraits)_", "", x)
  y <- gsub("\\.\\.", " | ", y)
  y <- gsub("\\.", " ", y)
  y <- gsub("_", " ", y)
  y <- sub("^enzyme activity \\| ", "", y)
  y <- sub(" \\| EC.*$", "", y)
  y <- sub("^growth \\| ", "", y)
  y <- gsub("\\s+", " ", y)
  y <- trimws(y)
  ifelse(nchar(y) > 34, paste0(substr(y, 1, 31), "..."), y)
}

cols16 <- setdiff(names(tr[["16S"]]), c(META_TR, EXCL16))
cls16  <- classify_traits(tr[["16S"]], cols16)
BOOL16 <- cls16$boolean
NUM16  <- cls16$numeric
cat(sprintf("16S: %d boolean, %d numeric, %d other\n",
            length(BOOL16), length(NUM16), length(cls16$other)))
if (length(cls16$other)) cat("16S other columns:", paste(cls16$other, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

## 2.2 Boolean and numeric tests / 布尔与数值检验

A boolean trait is modelled as `glm(y ~ log2(host_breadth), binomial)` on
annotated ASVs with `host_breadth >= 1`; the slope is the log2 OR per doubling
of host breadth. A trait is estimable when at least 100 ASVs are annotated and
each outcome class has at least 20 ASVs. BH correction is applied within trait
source (FAPROTAX2 / BugBase / MetaTraits) so that each annotation family forms
its own testing family.

Numeric traits use Spearman rho against host breadth over the same ASV set
(annotated, HB >= 1, at least 100 ASVs); BH is applied across the 15 metaTraits
columns.

```{r helpers-tests}
fit_boolean <- function(y, h, min_n = 100L, min_events = 20L) {
  ok <- !is.na(y) & !is.na(h) & h >= 1
  n <- sum(ok)
  if (n < min_n) {
    return(data.table(n = n, n_true = NA_integer_, prevalence = NA_real_,
                      log2OR = NA_real_, se = NA_real_, p = NA_real_,
                      flag = "n_annot_lt_100"))
  }
  yb <- as.integer(y[ok]); hh <- h[ok]
  nt <- sum(yb == 1L)
  if (min(nt, n - nt) < min_events) {
    return(data.table(n = n, n_true = nt, prevalence = nt / n,
                      log2OR = NA_real_, se = NA_real_, p = NA_real_,
                      flag = "events_lt_20"))
  }
  m <- tryCatch(suppressWarnings(glm(yb ~ log2(hh), family = binomial())),
                error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(m)) {
    return(data.table(n = n, n_true = nt, prevalence = nt / n,
                      log2OR = NA_real_, se = NA_real_, p = NA_real_,
                      flag = "fit_failed"))
  }
  cf <- coef(summary(m))
  if (!"log2(hh)" %in% rownames(cf) || !is.finite(cf["log2(hh)", "Estimate"])) {
    return(data.table(n = n, n_true = nt, prevalence = nt / n,
                      log2OR = NA_real_, se = NA_real_,
                      p = if ("log2(hh)" %in% rownames(cf))
                        cf["log2(hh)", 4] else NA_real_,
                      flag = "not_estimable"))
  }
  est <- cf["log2(hh)", "Estimate"]; se <- cf["log2(hh)", "Std. Error"]
  data.table(n = n, n_true = nt, prevalence = nt / n,
             log2OR = est, se = se, p = cf["log2(hh)", 4], flag = "ok")
}

run_boolean <- function(d, traits, h, min_n = 100L, min_events = 20L) {
  r <- rbindlist(lapply(traits, function(tc) {
    y <- to_logical(d[[tc]][match(names(h), d$taxid)])
    cbind(data.table(trait = tc, source = trait_source(tc)),
          fit_boolean(y, h, min_n, min_events))
  }), fill = TRUE)
  r[, `:=`(OR    = exp(log2OR),
           OR_lo = exp(log2OR - 1.96 * se),
           OR_hi = exp(log2OR + 1.96 * se))]
  r[, FDR := NA_real_]
  r[flag == "ok", FDR := p.adjust(p, method = "BH"), by = source]
  r[, state := fcase(
    flag != "ok", "Not estimable",
    FDR < 0.05 & log2OR > 0, "Positive",
    FDR < 0.05 & log2OR < 0, "Negative",
    default = "Not significant")]
  r[]
}

fit_numeric <- function(x, h, min_n = 100L) {
  ok <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(h) & h >= 1
  n <- sum(ok)
  if (n < min_n || uniqueN(h[ok]) < 3L) {
    return(data.table(n = n, rho = NA_real_, p = NA_real_,
                      flag = "n_annot_lt_100"))
  }
  ct <- tryCatch(cor.test(x[ok], h[ok], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE),
                 error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(ct)) {
    return(data.table(n = n, rho = NA_real_, p = NA_real_, flag = "fit_failed"))
  }
  data.table(n = n, rho = unname(ct$estimate), p = ct$p.value, flag = "ok")
}

run_numeric <- function(d, traits, h) {
  r <- rbindlist(lapply(traits, function(tc) {
    x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d[[tc]][match(names(h), d$taxid)]))
    cbind(data.table(trait = tc, source = trait_source(tc)),
          fit_numeric(x, h))
  }), fill = TRUE)
  r[, FDR := NA_real_]
  r[flag == "ok", FDR := p.adjust(p, method = "BH")]
  r[, state := fcase(
    flag != "ok", "Not estimable",
    FDR < 0.05 & rho > 0, "Positive",
    FDR < 0.05 & rho < 0, "Negative",
    default = "Not significant")]
  r[]
}
```

## 2.3 KO presence test / KO 存在性检验

The PICRUSt2 matrix is converted to presence/absence (`count > 0`). Because the
only covariate is `log2(host_breadth)`, ASVs with the same host breadth are
interchangeable: per-KO presence counts are aggregated within each host-breadth
value and a binomial logistic model is fitted by vectorised IRLS, which is
numerically identical to an ASV-level `glm` and much faster across ~10,000 KOs.
The p value is a likelihood-ratio test (df = 1). A KO is estimable when both
presence and absence have at least 20 ASVs within the analysed pool (`min_events`).
BH is applied across KOs within a pool.

```{r helpers-ko}
ko_fit <- function(cnt, nb, bins, ko_names, min_events = 20L) {
  N <- sum(nb)
  n1 <- colSums(cnt)
  keep <- n1 >= min_events & (N - n1) >= min_events
  if (!any(keep)) return(NULL)
  K <- cnt[, keep, drop = FALSE]
  ko <- ko_names[keep]
  M <- ncol(K)
  x <- log2(bins)
  X <- cbind(1, x)
  Nm <- matrix(rep(nb, M), nrow = length(nb))
  nt <- colSums(K)
  B <- rbind(qlogis(nt / N), rep(0, M))
  conv <- rep(FALSE, M)
  s0 <- s1 <- s2 <- det <- NULL
  for (it in 1:60) {
    L <- X %*% B
    L[L > 30] <- 30; L[L < -30] <- -30
    P <- plogis(L)
    R <- K - Nm * P
    W <- Nm * P * (1 - P) + 1e-12
    s0 <- colSums(W); s1 <- colSums(x * W); s2 <- colSums(x * x * W)
    S1 <- colSums(R); S2 <- colSums(x * R)
    det <- s0 * s2 - s1^2
    db0 <- (s2 * S1 - s1 * S2) / det
    db1 <- (-s1 * S1 + s0 * S2) / det
    B[1, ] <- B[1, ] + db0
    B[2, ] <- B[2, ] + db1
    conv <- abs(db0) < 1e-8 & abs(db1) < 1e-8
    if (all(conv)) break
  }
  beta <- B[2, ]
  se <- sqrt(s0 / det)
  P <- plogis(pmin(pmax(X %*% B, -30), 30))
  Pc <- pmin(pmax(P, 1e-10), 1 - 1e-10)
  dev_full <- -2 * colSums(K * log(Pc) + (Nm - K) * log(1 - Pc))
  ph <- pmin(pmax(nt / N, 1e-10), 1 - 1e-10)
  dev_null <- -2 * (nt * log(ph) + (N - nt) * log(1 - ph))
  p <- pchisq(dev_null - dev_full, df = 1, lower.tail = FALSE)
  r <- data.table(KO = ko, n = N, n_present = as.integer(nt),
                  prevalence = nt / N,
                  log2OR = beta, se = se, p = p,
                  converged = conv)
  r[, `:=`(OR    = exp(log2OR),
           OR_lo = exp(log2OR - 1.96 * se),
           OR_hi = exp(log2OR + 1.96 * se))]
  r[, near_sep := abs(log2OR) > 15]
  r[!converged | near_sep, `:=`(OR = NA_real_, OR_lo = NA_real_,
                                OR_hi = NA_real_)]
  r[, flag := fifelse(!converged, "not_converged",
                      fifelse(near_sep, "near_separation", "ok"))]
  r[, FDR := p.adjust(p, method = "BH")]
  r[, state := fcase(
    flag != "ok", "Not estimable",
    FDR < 0.05 & log2OR > 0, "Positive",
    FDR < 0.05 & log2OR < 0, "Negative",
    default = "Not significant")]
  r[]
}

KO_STATE <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
get_ko_matrix <- function(force = FALSE) {
  if (!is.null(KO_STATE$mat) && !force) return(KO_STATE)
  f <- file.path(rds_dir(CHAPTER), "ko_presence.rds")
  if (file.exists(f) && !force) {
    progress("read cached KO presence matrix")
    obj <- readRDS(f)
    KO_STATE$ids <- obj$ids
    KO_STATE$mat <- obj$mat
  } else {
    progress("reading PICRUSt2 KO matrix (this is the slow part)")
    d <- fread(KO_FILE, sep = "\t", header = TRUE,
               check.names = FALSE, na.strings = c("NA", ""))
    ids <- as.character(d[[1L]])
    m <- as.matrix(d[, -1L])
    rm(d); invisible(gc())
    if (anyNA(m)) m[is.na(m)] <- 0
    m <- m > 0
    KO_STATE$ids <- ids
    KO_STATE$mat <- m
    saveRDS(list(ids = ids, mat = m), f)
    progress(sprintf("KO matrix saved: %d ASVs x %d KOs", nrow(m), ncol(m)))
  }
  KO_STATE$ko <- colnames(KO_STATE$mat)
  KO_STATE
}

ko_test_set <- function(obj, asv_ids, h_by_asv, min_events = 20L) {
  h <- h_by_asv[match(obj$ids, asv_ids)]
  ok <- !is.na(h) & h >= 1
  if (sum(ok) < 100L) return(NULL)
  hh <- h[ok]
  bins <- sort(unique(hh))
  gi <- match(hh, bins)
  nb <- tabulate(gi, nbins = length(bins))
  cnt <- rowsum(obj$mat[ok, , drop = FALSE] + 0L, gi, reorder = TRUE)
  ko_fit(cnt, nb, bins, obj$ko, min_events = min_events)
}
```

# 3. Merged analysis / 合并分析

Host breadth across all qualified genera of a kingdom (Chapter 4, main
analysis). The 16S merged analysis covers 118 boolean traits, 15 numeric traits
and the PICRUSt2 KOs.

```{r merged-traits}
CACHE_TR <- file.path(rds_dir(CHAPTER), "trait_merged.rds")
if (file.exists(CACHE_TR) && !FORCE) {
  merged_tr <- readRDS(CACHE_TR)
  progress("loaded merged trait cache")
} else {
  progress("merged traits: 16S boolean")
  bool16_merged <- run_boolean(tr[["16S"]], BOOL16, hb16)
  progress("merged traits: 16S numeric")
  num16_merged <- run_numeric(tr[["16S"]], NUM16, hb16)
  merged_tr <- list(boolean = bool16_merged, numeric = num16_merged)
  saveRDS(merged_tr, CACHE_TR)
}
bool16_merged <- merged_tr$boolean
num16_merged  <- merged_tr$numeric

cat(sprintf("16S boolean: %d tested, %d FDR<0.05 (%d pos, %d neg)\n",
            sum(bool16_merged$flag == "ok"),
            sum(bool16_merged$FDR < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
            sum(bool16_merged$FDR < 0.05 & bool16_merged$log2OR > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
            sum(bool16_merged$FDR < 0.05 & bool16_merged$log2OR < 0, na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("16S numeric: %d tested, %d FDR<0.05\n",
            sum(num16_merged$flag == "ok"),
            sum(num16_merged$FDR < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)))
```

```{r merged-ko}
CACHE_KO <- file.path(rds_dir(CHAPTER), "ko_merged.rds")
if (file.exists(CACHE_KO) && !FORCE) {
  ko_merged <- readRDS(CACHE_KO)
  progress("loaded merged KO cache")
} else {
  obj <- get_ko_matrix()
  progress(sprintf("merged KO: %d ASVs x %d KOs", nrow(obj$mat), ncol(obj$mat)))
  ko_merged <- ko_test_set(obj, tr[["16S"]]$taxid, hb16, min_events = 1L)
  saveRDS(ko_merged, CACHE_KO)
  progress("merged KO done")
}
cat(sprintf("KO merged: %d tested, %d FDR<0.05 (%d pos, %d neg); %d not converged\n",
            nrow(ko_merged), sum(ko_merged$FDR < 0.05),
            sum(ko_merged$FDR < 0.05 & ko_merged$log2OR > 0),
            sum(ko_merged$FDR < 0.05 & ko_merged$log2OR < 0),
            sum(ko_merged$flag != "ok")))
```

# 4. Pool-wise analysis / 分池分析

Each of the 7 qualified 16S pools (Coarse A, Coarse B and Medium; the
region-level grain is not analysed, see Chapter 4) is re-analysed with its own
host-breadth values. A trait must have at least 100 annotated ASVs with
`host_breadth >= 1`
and at least 20 ASVs in each outcome class; KOs use the same 20/20 rule. FDR is
computed within pool (and within trait source for the boolean traits). Pools are
not pooled statistically; cross-pool summaries only compare signs and
significance.

```{r pools-traits}
CACHE_TP <- file.path(rds_dir(CHAPTER), "trait_pools.rds")
if (file.exists(CACHE_TP) && !FORCE) {
  trait_pools <- readRDS(CACHE_TP)
  progress("loaded pool trait cache")
} else {
  bl <- list(); nl <- list()
  for (pool_id in POOLS16) {
    h <- setNames(hb_pools[[pool_id]], tr[["16S"]]$taxid)
    bl[[pool_id]] <- run_boolean(tr[["16S"]], BOOL16, h)[, pool := pool_id]
    nl[[pool_id]] <- run_numeric(tr[["16S"]], NUM16, h)[, pool := pool_id]
    progress(sprintf("pool traits %s done", pool_id))
  }
  trait_pools <- list(boolean = rbindlist(bl, fill = TRUE),
                      numeric = rbindlist(nl, fill = TRUE))
  trait_pools$boolean <- merge(
    trait_pools$boolean,
    pools16[, .(pool, grain = as.character(grain))], by = "pool", all.x = TRUE)
  trait_pools$numeric <- merge(
    trait_pools$numeric,
    pools16[, .(pool, grain = as.character(grain))], by = "pool", all.x = TRUE)
  saveRDS(trait_pools, CACHE_TP)
}
# Per-pool results are unchanged by retaining only the analysis pools.
# 仅保留纳入分析的池，单池结果不变。
trait_pools$boolean <- trait_pools$boolean[pool %in% POOLS16]
trait_pools$numeric <- trait_pools$numeric[pool %in% POOLS16]
pool_bool <- trait_pools$boolean
pool_num  <- trait_pools$numeric
cat(sprintf("pool boolean: %d rows; %d pool-trait pairs estimable\n",
            nrow(pool_bool), sum(pool_bool$flag == "ok")))
cat(sprintf("pool numeric: %d rows; %d pool-trait pairs estimable\n",
            nrow(pool_num), sum(pool_num$flag == "ok")))
```

```{r pools-ko}
CACHE_KP <- file.path(rds_dir(CHAPTER), "ko_pools.rds")
if (file.exists(CACHE_KP) && !FORCE) {
  ko_pools <- readRDS(CACHE_KP)
  progress("loaded pool KO cache")
} else {
  obj <- get_ko_matrix()
  ko_pools <- list()
  for (pool_id in POOLS16) {
    h <- setNames(hb_pools[[pool_id]], tr[["16S"]]$taxid)
    ko_pools[[pool_id]] <- ko_test_set(obj, tr[["16S"]]$taxid, h,
                                       min_events = 20L)[, pool := pool_id]
    progress(sprintf("pool KO %s done", pool_id))
  }
  saveRDS(ko_pools, CACHE_KP)
}
# Per-pool KO fits are independent; retain the Chapter 4 analysis pools.
# 单池 KO 拟合相互独立，仅保留第四章纳入分析的池。
ko_pools <- ko_pools[intersect(POOLS16, names(ko_pools))]
ko_pool <- rbindlist(ko_pools, fill = TRUE)
ko_pool <- merge(ko_pool,
                 pools16[, .(pool, grain = as.character(grain))],
                 by = "pool", all.x = TRUE)
for (pool_id in POOLS16) {
  d <- ko_pool[pool == pool_id]
  cat(sprintf("%-22s tested=%5d  FDR<0.05=%4d (pos %3d / neg %3d)\n",
              pool_id, nrow(d), sum(d$FDR < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
              sum(d$FDR < 0.05 & d$log2OR > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
              sum(d$FDR < 0.05 & d$log2OR < 0, na.rm = TRUE)))
}
# release the large logical matrix once both KO sections are done
if (!is.null(KO_STATE$mat)) {
  rm(list = ls(KO_STATE), envir = KO_STATE)
  invisible(gc())
}
```

# 5. KO annotation and cross-pool KOs / KO 注释与跨池 KO

KEGG level-2 and PGPG level-3 labels are attached to each KO for the result
tables and the sankey views. A KO can map to several KEGG pathways and several
PGPG terms; the first annotation in file order is stored so that every KO
contributes one count (no double counting).

For the classification figure the KOs are grouped against the merged analysis
and the two seed/germ pools. Because the merged analysis aggregates all samples,
the two concordant sets are nested in the merged sets: a **Seed+ & Germ+** KO is
significant with a positive slope in the merged analysis and in both the Seed
and Germ pools (three-way concordance), and a **Seed- & Germ-** KO is significant
with a negative slope in all three. Every other KO is described by its merged
status alone (Merged+, Merged- or Merged NS). KOs whose merged fit did not
converge are excluded. The five sets therefore overlap at the two ends; the
sankey figure compares their functional composition rather than tracking
individual KOs.

```{r ko-annotation}
ko_level <- fread(KO_LEVEL_FILE, sep = "\t",
                  na.strings = "", quote = "",
                  select = c("level2", "KO", "KO_name"))
ko_level[, level2 := trimws(level2)]
ko_level[, KO_name := trimws(KO_name)]
ko_map <- ko_level[!duplicated(KO)]
pgpg <- fread(PGPG_FILE, sep = "\t",
              select = c("KO", "Lv1", "Lv2", "Lv3"))
ko_pgpg <- pgpg[!duplicated(KO)]

ko_annot <- merge(ko_map, ko_pgpg, by = "KO", all = TRUE)
ko_annot[is.na(level2) | level2 == "", level2 := "Unclassified"]
ko_annot[is.na(Lv3) | Lv3 == "", Lv3 := "Unknown"]
write_int(ko_annot, CHAPTER, "ko_annotation")

# KO sets for the sankey figure. The Seed/Germ concordant sets require the
# merged analysis to agree as well, so both ends of the figure are nested in
# the Merged+/Merged- sets (three-way concordance).
state_of <- function(flag, fdr, eff) {
  fifelse(flag != "ok", "Not estimable",
    fifelse(!is.na(fdr) & fdr < 0.05,
            fifelse(eff > 0, "Positive", "Negative"), "Not significant"))
}
ko_class <- ko_merged[, .(KO, merged = state_of(flag, FDR, log2OR))]
ko_class <- merge(
  ko_class,
  ko_pool[pool == "16S Seed",
          .(KO, seed = state_of(flag, FDR, log2OR))],
  by = "KO", all.x = TRUE)
ko_class <- merge(
  ko_class,
  ko_pool[pool == "16S Germ",
          .(KO, germ = state_of(flag, FDR, log2OR))],
  by = "KO", all.x = TRUE)
ko_class[is.na(seed), seed := "Not estimable"]
ko_class[is.na(germ), germ := "Not estimable"]
ko_sets <- list(
  `Seed+ & Germ+` = ko_class[merged == "Positive" & seed == "Positive" &
                               germ == "Positive", KO],
  `Merged+`       = ko_class[merged == "Positive", KO],
  `Merged NS`     = ko_class[merged == "Not significant", KO],
  `Merged-`       = ko_class[merged == "Negative", KO],
  `Seed- & Germ-` = ko_class[merged == "Negative" & seed == "Negative" &
                               germ == "Negative", KO])
ko_class[, `:=`(in_SeedGerm_pos = KO %in% ko_sets[[1]],
                in_Merged_pos   = KO %in% ko_sets[[2]],
                in_Merged_NS    = KO %in% ko_sets[[3]],
                in_Merged_neg   = KO %in% ko_sets[[4]],
                in_SeedGerm_neg = KO %in% ko_sets[[5]])]
write_int(ko_class, CHAPTER, "ko_seed_germ_class")
cat(sprintf("KO sets: %s\n",
            paste(sprintf("%s=%d", names(ko_sets), lengths(ko_sets)),
                  collapse = ", ")))
```

# 6. Cross-pool consistency / 跨池一致性

For every trait (and KO) the number of estimable pools, the number of pools with
a significant positive and negative association, and the median effect are
summarised. A trait is **consistent** when at least 70%
of its estimable pools are significant in the same direction; at least three
estimable pools are required before a trait can be called consistent (a single
pool cannot establish consistency). Traits significant in only some pools are
**context-specific**. The three-pool minimum is a guard, not a significance
threshold, and is stated in the table.

```{r consistency}
cons_bool <- pool_bool[flag == "ok", .(
  n_estimable = .N,
  n_sig_pos = sum(FDR < 0.05 & log2OR > 0),
  n_sig_neg = sum(FDR < 0.05 & log2OR < 0),
  median_log2OR = median(log2OR)
), by = .(trait, source)]
cons_num <- pool_num[flag == "ok", .(
  n_estimable = .N,
  n_sig_pos = sum(FDR < 0.05 & rho > 0),
  n_sig_neg = sum(FDR < 0.05 & rho < 0),
  median_rho = median(rho)
), by = .(trait, source)]
cons_ko <- ko_pool[flag == "ok", .(
  n_estimable = .N,
  n_sig_pos = sum(FDR < 0.05 & log2OR > 0),
  n_sig_neg = sum(FDR < 0.05 & log2OR < 0),
  median_log2OR = median(log2OR)
), by = .(trait = KO)]
cons_ko[, source := "PICRUSt2"]

classify_consistency <- function(d, type, estimate_col) {
  d <- copy(d)
  d[, `:=`(frac_pos = n_sig_pos / n_estimable,
           frac_neg = n_sig_neg / n_estimable)]
  d[, consistency := fcase(
    n_estimable < 3L, "Insufficient pools",
    frac_pos >= 0.7, "Consistent positive",
    frac_neg >= 0.7, "Consistent negative",
    n_sig_pos + n_sig_neg > 0L, "Context-specific",
    default = "Not significant")]
  d[, `:=`(type = type,
           estimate = get(estimate_col))]
  for (cc in intersect(c("median_log2OR", "median_rho", "estimate_col"),
                       names(d))) d[, (cc) := NULL]
  setcolorder(d, c("type", "source", "trait", "n_estimable", "n_sig_pos",
                   "n_sig_neg", "frac_pos", "frac_neg", "estimate",
                   "consistency"))
  d[]
}
cons <- rbindlist(list(
  classify_consistency(cons_bool, "boolean", "median_log2OR"),
  classify_consistency(cons_num,  "numeric", "median_rho"),
  classify_consistency(cons_ko,   "ko",      "median_log2OR")
), fill = TRUE)
cat("Consistency classes:\n")
print(cons[, .N, by = .(type, consistency)][order(type, consistency)])
```

# 8. Figures / 图件

All figures use the 8 pt Arial house style. Effects are HBS-only (no NRH
contrast). Heatmaps and forests use the chapter palette (orange = positive,
blue = negative); the volcanoes use annotation-family palettes. In the two
volcanoes, point shape encodes cross-pool concordance: triangles mark traits
significant in both the Seed and Germ pools in the same direction, squares mark
opposite directions, and circles mark all other traits.

## 8.1 Boolean trait volcano (merged 16S) / 布尔性状火山图

```{r fig-boolean-volcano}
# point shape: Seed and Germ pools both significant in the same direction
# (triangle) or in opposite directions (square); all other traits are circles
seed_germ_shape <- function(d, eff) {
  sig_rows <- function(pp) d[pool == pp & flag == "ok" & !is.na(FDR) &
                               FDR < 0.05, .(trait, sgn = sign(get(eff)))]
  sm <- merge(sig_rows("16S Seed"), sig_rows("16S Germ"), by = "trait",
              suffixes = c("_seed", "_germ"))
  out <- data.table(trait = unique(d$trait), shape = "Other")
  out[trait %in% sm[sgn_seed == sgn_germ, trait], shape := "Same direction"]
  out[trait %in% sm[sgn_seed != sgn_germ, trait], shape := "Opposite direction"]
  out[, shape := factor(shape, levels = c("Same direction",
                                          "Opposite direction", "Other"))]
  out
}
SHAPE_VALS <- c(`Same direction` = 17, `Opposite direction` = 15, Other = 16)
# legend labels carry the number of traits in each shape class
shape_labs <- function(d) {
  tb <- table(factor(d$shape, levels = names(SHAPE_VALS)))
  setNames(sprintf("%s (n=%d)", names(tb), as.integer(tb)), names(tb))
}

bool_volcano <- function(r) {
  d <- copy(r[flag == "ok"])
  d <- merge(d, seed_germ_shape(pool_bool, "log2OR"), by = "trait",
             all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
  d[, `:=`(neglog10FDR = -log10(pmax(FDR, 1e-300)),
           sig = FDR < 0.05)]
  # label the ten most significant positive and five most significant negative
  # traits
  lab_pos <- d[sig == TRUE & log2OR > 0][order(FDR)][1:min(10, .N)]
  lab_neg <- d[sig == TRUE & log2OR < 0][order(FDR)][1:min(5, .N)]
  labs <- rbind(lab_pos, lab_neg)
  labs[, label := short_label(trait)]
  cat(sprintf("boolean volcano: %d points (%d same, %d opposite, %d other); %d labelled\n",
              nrow(d), sum(d$shape == "Same direction"),
              sum(d$shape == "Opposite direction"),
              sum(d$shape == "Other"), nrow(labs)))
  ggplot(d, aes(log2OR, neglog10FDR, shape = shape)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed",
               colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_point(aes(colour = source), size = 1.5, alpha = 0.85) +
    geom_text_repel(data = labs,
                    aes(x = log2OR, y = neglog10FDR, label = label),
                    inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 2.0, colour = "black",
                    max.overlaps = Inf, segment.size = 0.18,
                    min.segment.length = 0, seed = 20261121,
                    show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(FAPROTAX2 = "#F4A261",
                                   BugBase = "#547FB6",
                                   MetaTraits = "#7DCEA0"),
                        name = "Trait source") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = SHAPE_VALS, name = "Seed/Germ",
                       labels = shape_labs(d)) +
    labs(x = "log2 OR per doubling of host breadth",
         y = expression(-log[10]("BH-FDR"))) +
    theme_seed(8) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.box = "vertical",
          legend.key.size = unit(0.25, "cm"),
          legend.spacing.x = unit(0.1, "cm")) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 1, order = 1),
           shape = guide_legend(nrow = 2, order = 2))
}
save_fig(bool_volcano(bool16_merged), CHAPTER, "Fig_5_boolean_volcano", 90, 104)
embed_fig(CHAPTER, "Fig_5_boolean_volcano")
```

## 8.2 Numeric trait volcano (merged 16S) / 数值性状火山图

```{r fig-numeric-volcano}
num_family <- function(t) {
  ifelse(grepl("temperature|pH|salinity", t), "Physiology",
    ifelse(grepl("GC|coding.density", t), "Genome composition",
           "Genome size/count"))
}
num_volcano <- function(r) {
  # all estimable traits are plotted; only FDR < 0.05 traits are labelled
  d <- copy(r[flag == "ok"])
  d <- merge(d, seed_germ_shape(pool_num, "rho"), by = "trait",
             all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
  d[, `:=`(neglog10FDR = -log10(pmax(FDR, 1e-300)),
           sig = FDR < 0.05,
           family = num_family(trait),
           label = short_label(trait))]
  labs <- d[sig == TRUE]
  cat(sprintf("numeric volcano: %d points, %d labelled\n", nrow(d), nrow(labs)))
  ggplot(d, aes(rho, neglog10FDR, colour = family, shape = shape)) +

               colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_point(size = 2.2, alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_text_repel(data = labs,
                    aes(x = rho, y = neglog10FDR, label = label),
                    inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 2.6, colour = "black",
                    max.overlaps = Inf, segment.size = 0.18,
                    min.segment.length = 0, force = 1.5, box.padding = 0.45,
                    seed = 20261121, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(Physiology = "#F2CC8F",
                                   `Genome composition` = "#A8DADC",
                                   `Genome size/count` = "#A7C957"),
                        name = "Trait family") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = SHAPE_VALS, name = "Seed/Germ",
                       labels = shape_labs(d)) +
    labs(x = "Spearman rho with host breadth",
         y = expression(-log[10]("BH-FDR"))) +
    theme_seed(8) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.box = "vertical",
          legend.key.size = unit(0.25, "cm")) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 2, order = 1),
           shape = guide_legend(nrow = 2, order = 2))
}
save_fig(num_volcano(num16_merged), CHAPTER, "Fig_5_numeric_volcano", 90, 108)
embed_fig(CHAPTER, "Fig_5_numeric_volcano")
```

## 8.3 Boolean trait heatmaps across pools / 布尔性状热图

The boolean heatmap is split into two figures. The first shows every trait that
is significant with the same direction in the merged analysis and in both the
Seed and Germ pools (positive above, negative below); the four traits that are
also NSD-positive are shown first, the other positive traits are ordered by the
NSD log2 OR and negative traits by the merged log2 OR. The second shows every
trait that is significant
in both the Seed and Germ pools but in opposite directions (Germ-positive above,
Germ-negative below). Columns are the merged analysis and the seven qualified
pools; fill is the signed log2 OR clipped at ±2; stars mark FDR tiers within
the column (`*` < 0.05, `**` < 0.01, `***` < 0.001); grey tiles are traits that
were not estimable in that column.

```{r fig-boolean-heatmap}
# three-tier significance markers used by the heatmaps and the forest
fdr_star <- function(fdr, flag = "ok") {
  fifelse(flag != "ok" | is.na(fdr), "",
    fifelse(fdr < 0.001, "***",
      fifelse(fdr < 0.01, "**", fifelse(fdr < 0.05, "*", ""))))
}

boolean_heatmap <- function(d, dm, rows) {
  pools <- c("16S merged", POOLS16)
  dm <- dm[, .(pool = "16S merged", trait, source, log2OR, FDR, flag)]
  dd <- rbind(d[, .(pool, trait, source, log2OR, FDR, flag)], dm, fill = TRUE)
  dd <- merge(CJ(trait = rows, pool = pools), dd,
              by = c("trait", "pool"), all.x = TRUE)
  dd[, `:=`(fill_val = fifelse(flag == "ok", log2OR, NA_real_),
            star_lab = fdr_star(FDR, flag))]
  grain_map <- setNames(as.character(pools16$grain), pools16$pool)
  grain_map["16S merged"] <- "Merged"
  dd[, `:=`(pool = factor(pool, levels = pools),
            grain = factor(grain_map[as.character(pool)],
                           levels = c("Merged", "Coarse A", "Coarse B",
                                      "Medium")),
            trait = factor(trait, levels = rev(rows)))]
  x_labs <- setNames(sub("^16S ", "", pools), pools)
  x_labs["16S merged"] <- "Merged"
  src_map <- c(FAPROTAX2 = "FP", BugBase = "BB", MetaTraits = "MT")
  src_by_trait <- setNames(d$source[match(rows, d$trait)], rows)
  y_labs <- setNames(
    paste0(src_map[src_by_trait[rev(rows)]], " ", short_label(rev(rows))),
    rev(rows))
  ggplot(dd, aes(pool, trait)) +
    geom_tile(aes(fill = fill_val), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_text(aes(label = star_lab), size = 2.2, family = "Arial",
              colour = "black") +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = COL_NEG, mid = "white", high = COL_POS,
                         midpoint = 0, limits = c(-2, 2), oob = scales::squish,
                         na.value = "grey90", breaks = -2:2,
                         name = "log2 OR per doubling of host breadth") +
    facet_grid(~grain, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = x_labs) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = y_labs) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_seed(8) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 6.5),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6.5),
          strip.text = element_text(size = 7),
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.title = element_text(size = 7))
}

# trait states in the merged analysis and in the Seed/Germ pools
b_long <- rbind(
  pool_bool[, .(pool, trait, source, log2OR, FDR, flag)],
  bool16_merged[, .(pool = "16S merged", trait, source, log2OR, FDR, flag)])
b_long[, state := fifelse(flag != "ok" | is.na(FDR), NA_character_,
  fifelse(FDR < 0.05, fifelse(log2OR > 0, "Positive", "Negative"),
          "Not significant"))]
b_state <- merge(
  merge(b_long[pool == "16S Seed",
               .(trait, seed = state, seed_or = log2OR)],
        b_long[pool == "16S Germ",
               .(trait, germ = state, germ_or = log2OR)], by = "trait"),
  b_long[pool == "16S NSD",
         .(trait, nsd = state, nsd_or = log2OR)], by = "trait")
b_state <- merge(
  b_state,
  b_long[pool == "16S merged",
         .(trait, merged = state, merged_or = log2OR)], by = "trait")

# figure 1: merged, Seed and Germ all significant in the same direction.
# Four designated traits (all also NSD-positive) sit at the top in this order;
# the remaining concordant-positive traits are ordered by the NSD log2 OR from
# positive to negative. Negative traits are ordered by the merged log2 OR.
top_pos_fixed <- c(
  "bugbase_Contains_Mobile_Elements",
  "bugbase_Potentially_Pathogenic",
  "metatraits_growth..glycerol",
  "faprotax_arsenite_oxidation_energy_yielding")
pos_block <- b_state[merged == "Positive" & seed == "Positive" &
                       germ == "Positive"]
stopifnot(all(top_pos_fixed %in% pos_block$trait))
rows_c_pos <- c(top_pos_fixed,
                pos_block[!trait %in% top_pos_fixed][order(-nsd_or), trait])
rows_c_neg <- b_state[merged == "Negative" & seed == "Negative" &
                        germ == "Negative"][order(merged_or), trait]
rows_conc <- c(rows_c_pos, rows_c_neg)
height_conc <- max(120, 40 + 3.2 * length(rows_conc))
p_bool_conc <- boolean_heatmap(pool_bool, bool16_merged, rows_conc)

# figure 2: Seed and Germ significant in opposite directions
rows_d_pos <- b_state[germ == "Positive" & seed == "Negative"
                      ][order(-germ_or), trait]
rows_d_neg <- b_state[germ == "Negative" & seed == "Positive"
                      ][order(germ_or), trait]
rows_disc <- c(rows_d_pos, rows_d_neg)
p_bool_disc <- boolean_heatmap(pool_bool, bool16_merged, rows_disc)
cat(sprintf(paste0("boolean heatmaps: concordant %d (+%d / -%d); ",
                   "discordant %d (Germ+ %d / Germ- %d); height %.0f mm\n"),
            length(rows_conc), length(rows_c_pos), length(rows_c_neg),
            length(rows_disc), length(rows_d_pos), length(rows_d_neg),
            height_conc))
```

## 8.4 Numeric trait heatmap across pools / 数值性状热图

The numeric rows use the same merged + seven-pool columns and are split for the
combined figures: concordant rows (merged + Seed + Germ all positive or all
negative) and the Seed/Germ opposite rows. The remaining numeric traits are
covered by the numeric volcano and forest rather than a separate heatmap. Fill
is the Spearman rho clipped at ±0.25; stars mark FDR tiers (`*` < 0.05,
`**` < 0.01, `***` < 0.001); grey tiles are not estimable.

```{r fig-numeric-heatmap}
numeric_heatmap <- function(d, dm, rows) {
  d <- copy(d)
  pools <- c("16S merged", POOLS16)
  dm <- dm[, .(pool = "16S merged", trait, rho, FDR, flag)]
  dd <- rbind(d[, .(pool, trait, rho, FDR, flag)], dm, fill = TRUE)
  dd <- merge(CJ(trait = rows, pool = pools), dd,
              by = c("trait", "pool"), all.x = TRUE)
  dd[, `:=`(fill_val = fifelse(flag == "ok", rho, NA_real_),
            star_lab = fdr_star(FDR, flag))]
  grain_map <- setNames(as.character(pools16$grain), pools16$pool)
  grain_map["16S merged"] <- "Merged"
  dd[, `:=`(pool = factor(pool, levels = pools),
            grain = factor(grain_map[as.character(pool)],
                           levels = c("Merged", "Coarse A", "Coarse B",
                                      "Medium")),
            trait = factor(trait, levels = rev(rows)))]
  x_labs <- setNames(sub("^16S ", "", pools), pools)
  x_labs["16S merged"] <- "Merged"
  y_labs <- setNames(short_label(rev(rows)), rev(rows))
  ggplot(dd, aes(pool, trait)) +
    geom_tile(aes(fill = fill_val), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_text(aes(label = star_lab), size = 2.2, family = "Arial") +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = COL_NEG, mid = "white", high = COL_POS,
                         midpoint = 0, limits = c(-0.25, 0.25),
                         oob = scales::squish, na.value = "grey90",
                         name = "Spearman rho") +
    facet_grid(~grain, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = x_labs) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = y_labs) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_seed(8) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 6.5),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6.5),
          strip.text = element_text(size = 7),
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.title = element_text(size = 7))
}
# Rows are grouped by direction: merged + Seed + Germ all positive, all
# negative, Seed-positive/Germ-negative, Seed-negative/Germ-positive, and the
# remaining traits (any other pattern) at the bottom.
n_long <- rbind(
  pool_num[, .(pool, trait, rho, FDR, flag)],
  num16_merged[, .(pool = "16S merged", trait, rho, FDR, flag)])
n_long[, state := fifelse(flag != "ok" | is.na(FDR), NA_character_,
  fifelse(FDR < 0.05, fifelse(rho > 0, "Positive", "Negative"),
          "Not significant"))]
n_state <- merge(
  merge(n_long[pool == "16S Seed", .(trait, seed = state)],
        n_long[pool == "16S Germ", .(trait, germ = state)], by = "trait"),
  n_long[pool == "16S merged",
         .(trait, merged = state, merged_rho = rho)], by = "trait")
n_state[, block := fcase(
  merged == "Positive" & seed == "Positive" & germ == "Positive", 1L,
  merged == "Negative" & seed == "Negative" & germ == "Negative", 2L,
  seed == "Positive" & germ == "Negative", 3L,
  seed == "Negative" & germ == "Positive", 4L,
  default = 5L)]
n_state[, ord := fcase(
  block %in% c(1L, 3L, 5L), -merged_rho,
  block %in% c(2L, 4L), merged_rho)]
setorder(n_state, block, ord)
cat(sprintf("numeric heatmap blocks: M+S+G+=%d, M-S-G-=%d, S+G-=%d, S-G+=%d, other=%d\n",
            sum(n_state$block == 1L), sum(n_state$block == 2L),
            sum(n_state$block == 3L), sum(n_state$block == 4L),
            sum(n_state$block == 5L)))
# numeric rows that match the two boolean blocks; the remaining numeric traits
# are covered by the numeric volcano and forest
rows_num_conc <- n_state[block %in% c(1L, 2L), trait]
rows_num_disc <- n_state[block %in% c(3L, 4L), trait]
p_num_conc <- numeric_heatmap(pool_num, num16_merged, rows_num_conc)
p_num_disc <- numeric_heatmap(pool_num, num16_merged, rows_num_disc)
```

## 8.5 Combined boolean and numeric heatmaps / 布尔与数值组合热图

The boolean rows selected above are stacked with the numeric rows that carry
the same direction pattern: the concordant numeric traits (merged + Seed + Germ
all positive or all negative) go under the concordant boolean block, and the
Seed/Germ opposite numeric trait goes under the discordant block. The boolean
block is on top and the numeric block below; the two blocks keep their own fill
scales (log2 OR and Spearman rho) and legends.

```{r fig-combined-heatmaps}
p_bool_conc_top <- p_bool_conc + theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())
p_bool_disc_top <- p_bool_disc + theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())
h_num_conc <- 60
h_num_disc <- 50
comb_conc <- (p_bool_conc_top / p_num_conc) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(height_conc, h_num_conc))
comb_disc <- (p_bool_disc_top / p_num_disc) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(88, h_num_disc))
save_fig(comb_conc, CHAPTER, "Fig_5_trait_heatmap_concordant", 153,
         height_conc + h_num_conc)
embed_fig(CHAPTER, "Fig_5_trait_heatmap_concordant")
save_fig(comb_disc, CHAPTER, "Fig_5_trait_heatmap_discordant", 153,
         88 + h_num_disc)
embed_fig(CHAPTER, "Fig_5_trait_heatmap_discordant")
cat(sprintf(paste0("combined heatmaps: concordant %d boolean + %d numeric; ",
                   "discordant %d boolean + %d numeric\n"),
            length(rows_conc), length(rows_num_conc),
            length(rows_disc), length(rows_num_disc)))
```

## 8.6 Boolean trait forest (merged 16S) / 布尔性状森林图

Only traits with FDR < 0.05 in the merged analysis are shown, in two columns:
FAPROTAX2 and BugBase on the left, MetaTraits on the right. Trait labels carry
FDR stars (`*` < 0.05, `**` < 0.01, `***` < 0.001). The x axis is the log2 OR
per doubling of host breadth with 95% Wald intervals.

```{r fig-boolean-forest}
bool_forest <- function(r, srcs) {
  d <- copy(r[flag == "ok" & FDR < 0.05 & source %in% srcs])
  if (!nrow(d)) return(NULL)
  d[, `:=`(direction = factor(fifelse(log2OR > 0, "Positive", "Negative"),
                              levels = c("Negative", "Positive")),
           source = factor(source, levels = srcs),
           log2OR_lo = log2OR - 1.96 * se,
           log2OR_hi = log2OR + 1.96 * se,
           label = paste0(short_label(trait), " ", fdr_star(FDR, flag)))]
  setorder(d, source, log2OR)
  d[, trait_f := factor(trait, levels = d$trait)]
  y_labs <- setNames(d$label, d$trait)
  ggplot(d, aes(log2OR, trait_f, colour = direction)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, colour = "grey45",
               linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = log2OR_lo, xmax = log2OR_hi),
                    size = 0.16, linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = y_labs) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(Negative = COL_NEG, Positive = COL_POS),
                        name = NULL) +
    labs(x = "log2 OR per doubling of host breadth", y = NULL) +
    facet_wrap(~ source, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y",
               strip.position = "top") +
    theme_seed(8) +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5.0),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 7),
          strip.text = element_text(size = 7),
          panel.spacing = unit(0.15, "lines"),
          legend.position = "bottom")
}
# two-column layout: FAPROTAX2 + BugBase on the left, MetaTraits on the right
f_bool_l <- bool_forest(bool16_merged, c("FAPROTAX2", "BugBase"))
f_bool_r <- bool_forest(bool16_merged, "MetaTraits")
p_forest <- (f_bool_l + f_bool_r +
               plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1.1), guides = "collect")) &
  theme(legend.position = "top")
n_left  <- nrow(f_bool_l$data)
n_right <- nrow(f_bool_r$data)
height_forest <- max(110, 30 + 2.0 * max(n_left, n_right))
save_fig(p_forest, CHAPTER, "Fig_5_boolean_forest", 160, height_forest)
embed_fig(CHAPTER, "Fig_5_boolean_forest")
cat(sprintf("boolean forest: %d significant traits (left %d, right %d); height %.0f mm\n",
            n_left + n_right, n_left, n_right, height_forest))
```

## 8.7 Numeric trait forest (merged 16S) / 数值性状森林图

The twelve numeric traits with FDR < 0.05 in the merged analysis are shown with
95% confidence intervals on the Spearman rho (Fisher z transformation). Trait
labels carry FDR stars and rows are ordered by rho. Points use the same orange
(positive) and blue (negative) colours as the boolean forest.

```{r fig-numeric-forest}
num_forest <- function(r) {
  d <- copy(r[flag == "ok" & FDR < 0.05])
  if (!nrow(d)) return(NULL)
  d[, `:=`(direction = factor(fifelse(rho > 0, "Positive", "Negative"),
                              levels = c("Negative", "Positive")),
           rho_lo = tanh(atanh(rho) - 1.96 / sqrt(n - 3)),
           rho_hi = tanh(atanh(rho) + 1.96 / sqrt(n - 3)),
           label = paste0(short_label(trait), " ", fdr_star(FDR, flag)))]
  setorder(d, rho)
  d[, trait_f := factor(trait, levels = d$trait)]
  y_labs <- setNames(d$label, d$trait)
  ggplot(d, aes(rho, trait_f, colour = direction)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, colour = "grey45",
               linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = rho_lo, xmax = rho_hi),
                    size = 0.2, linewidth = 0.35) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = y_labs) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(Negative = COL_NEG, Positive = COL_POS),
                        name = NULL) +
    labs(title = "MetaTraits numeric",
         x = "Spearman rho with host breadth", y = NULL) +
    theme_seed(8) +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6.5),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 7),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0),
          legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.key.size = unit(0.25, "cm"))
}
p_numforest <- num_forest(num16_merged)
save_fig(p_numforest, CHAPTER, "Fig_5_numeric_forest", 100, 76.5)
embed_fig(CHAPTER, "Fig_5_numeric_forest")
cat(sprintf("numeric forest: %d significant traits\n", nrow(p_numforest$data)))
```

## 8.8 Functional composition of the KO sets (Sankey) / KO 集合功能组成

Five KO sets are shown from left to right: Seed+ & Germ+, Merged+, Merged NS,
Merged- and Seed- & Germ-. The two concordant sets are nested in the merged
sets (every Seed+ & Germ+ KO is also Merged+), so the figure compares the
functional composition of overlapping sets rather than tracking individual KOs
across columns. Each column is normalised to 100% and the number of KOs is
printed above it; ribbons connect the same annotation category in adjacent
columns. The ten most frequent categories are shown individually and the
remainder are pooled as `Other`; the PGPG map keeps `Unknown` as its own
category. PGPG legend labels use readable English names from the old
map, and the KEGG panel uses the shared PAL2 palette. The two
maps are shown side by side with a single legend column at the far right (KEGG
above PGPG); in both maps components covering at least 3% of a column carry
their percentage inside the node.

```{r fig-ko-set-sankey}
CAT_COLS <- c(PAL_MULTI[1:10], "#D9D9D9")

ribbon_df <- function(x1, x2, y1min, y1max, y2min, y2max, id, cat, n = 80L) {
  tt <- seq(0, 1, length.out = n)
  ss <- tt * tt * (3 - 2 * tt)
  data.table(x = x1 + (x2 - x1) * tt,
             ymin = y1min + (y2min - y1min) * ss,
             ymax = y1max + (y2max - y1max) * ss,
             id = id, Category = cat)
}

ko_set_sankey <- function(sets, cat_col, top_n = 10L, unknown = FALSE,
                          label_map = NULL, pct_thr = NULL,
                          pal = CAT_COLS, legend_title = NULL) {
  GROUP_LEVELS <- names(sets)
  d <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_along(sets), function(i)
    data.table(KO = sets[[i]], Group = GROUP_LEVELS[i])))
  d <- merge(d, ko_annot[, .(KO, Category = get(cat_col))],
             by = "KO", all.x = TRUE)
  if (unknown) {
    d[is.na(Category) | Category == "", Category := "Unknown"]
  } else {
    d[is.na(Category) | Category == "", Category := "Unclassified"]
  }
  tt <- d[Category != "Unknown", .N, by = Category][order(-N, Category)]
  top_cats <- head(tt$Category, top_n)
  cat_levels <- c(top_cats, "Other", if (unknown) "Unknown")
  d[, Cat2 := ifelse(Category %in% top_cats, Category,
                     ifelse(unknown & Category == "Unknown", "Unknown",
                            "Other"))]
  full <- d[, .N, by = .(Group, Cat2)]
  full <- merge(CJ(Group = GROUP_LEVELS, Cat2 = cat_levels), full,
                by = c("Group", "Cat2"), all.x = TRUE)
  full[is.na(N), N := 0L]
  full[, `:=`(Group = factor(Group, levels = GROUP_LEVELS),
              Cat2 = factor(Cat2, levels = cat_levels))]
  full[, frac := N / sum(N), by = Group]
  stack_levels <- if (unknown) {
    c("Unknown", "Other", rev(top_cats))
  } else {
    c("Other", rev(top_cats))
  }
  nodes <- full[order(Group, match(as.character(Cat2), stack_levels))]
  nodes[, x := as.numeric(Group)]
  nodes[, ymax := cumsum(frac), by = Group]
  nodes[, ymin := ymax - frac]

  cols <- setNames(pal[seq_along(top_cats)], top_cats)
  cols["Other"] <- "#D9D9D9"
  if (unknown) cols["Unknown"] <- "#BDBDBD"

  # legend labels: optional map to readable names (PGPG), then wrap; node
  # percentages are drawn for components at or above pct_thr
  legend_labels <- cat_levels
  if (!is.null(label_map)) {
    mapped <- unname(label_map[cat_levels])
    legend_labels <- ifelse(is.na(mapped), cat_levels, mapped)
  }
  legend_labels <- vapply(legend_labels, function(s)
    paste(strwrap(s, width = 40), collapse = "\n"), character(1))
  pct_nodes <- if (is.null(pct_thr)) nodes[0] else nodes[frac >= pct_thr]
  if (nrow(pct_nodes)) {
    lum <- col2rgb(unname(cols[as.character(pct_nodes$Cat2)]))
    pct_nodes[, txt_col := ifelse(
      0.299 * lum[1, ] + 0.587 * lum[2, ] + 0.114 * lum[3, ] < 130,
      "white", "grey10")]
  }

  W <- 0.408
  ribbons <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(length(GROUP_LEVELS) - 1L), function(j) {
    L <- nodes[Group == GROUP_LEVELS[j]]
    R <- nodes[Group == GROUP_LEVELS[j + 1L]]
    rbindlist(lapply(cat_levels, function(cc) {
      yL <- L[Cat2 == cc]; yR <- R[Cat2 == cc]
      if (!nrow(yL) || !nrow(yR) || yL$frac <= 0 || yR$frac <= 0) return(NULL)
      ribbon_df(yL$x + W / 2, yR$x - W / 2, yL$ymin, yL$ymax,
                yR$ymin, yR$ymax, id = paste(j, cc, sep = "_"), cat = cc)
    }))
  }))
  col_tot <- full[, .(n_total = sum(N)), by = Group][order(Group)]
  col_tot[, x := as.numeric(Group)]
  x_labs <- c("Seed+ &\nGerm+", "Merged+", "Merged\nNS", "Merged-",
              "Seed- &\nGerm-")
  ggplot() +
    geom_ribbon(data = ribbons,
                aes(x = x, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, group = id,
                    fill = Category),
                alpha = 0.5, colour = NA) +
    geom_rect(data = nodes,
              aes(xmin = x - W / 2, xmax = x + W / 2,
                  ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = Cat2),
              colour = NA) +
    geom_text(data = pct_nodes,
              aes(x = x, y = (ymin + ymax) / 2,
                  label = sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * frac)),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 2.3, family = "Arial",
              colour = if (nrow(pct_nodes)) pct_nodes$txt_col else NULL) +
    geom_text(data = col_tot,
              aes(x = x, y = 1.035,
                  label = sprintf("n=%s", format(n_total, big.mark = ","))),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 2.4, vjust = 0) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols, name = legend_title,
                      labels = unname(legend_labels)) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq_along(GROUP_LEVELS), labels = x_labs,
                       limits = c(0.55, length(GROUP_LEVELS) + 0.45),
                       expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.10), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_void(base_size = 8) +
    theme(text = element_text(family = "Arial"),
          legend.position = "right",
          legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 6.7, lineheight = 0.9),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7, lineheight = 0.9,
                                     margin = margin(t = 3)),
          plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 8))
}

# PGPG Lv3 legend names are embedded so the figure is self-contained.
# 图中直接嵌入 PGPG Lv3 名称，避免外部依赖。
PGPG_MAP <- c(

kegg_set_sankey <- ko_set_sankey(ko_sets, "level2", top_n = 10L,
                                 unknown = FALSE, pct_thr = 0.03,
```

```{r log}
sink_file <- file.path(log_dir(CHAPTER), "ch5_summary.log")
lines <- c(
  sprintf("16S boolean tested %d; sig %d (pos %d, neg %d)",
          sum(bool16_merged$flag == "ok"),
          sum(bool16_merged$FDR < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
          sum(bool16_merged$FDR < 0.05 & bool16_merged$log2OR > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
          sum(bool16_merged$FDR < 0.05 & bool16_merged$log2OR < 0, na.rm = TRUE)),
  sprintf("16S numeric tested %d; sig %d",
          sum(num16_merged$flag == "ok"),

          sum(ko_merged$FDR < 0.05 & ko_merged$log2OR > 0),
```
